Identity withheld — A container-terminal operator, Logistics & Supply Chain sector, outcome-linked engagement, blended delivery team. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.
Berth planning static vs. yard reality; anchorage waits cost.
Cranes failed unscheduled; throughput lost. Ransomware exposure post-industry incidents; recovery untested.

The planning platform unified vessel/yard/tide data with scenario engines; crane telemetry drives predictive maintenance; a Quanta tournament on stowage formulations delivered 5% handling-time gains (industrialized); and IT/OT segmentation plus restore-tested recovery proved restart at 6 hours in drills.

blocks.x: The three things that made it hold

items: lineage and freshness were design constraints from week one, so the measurement never became the controversy.
the twin drifted when the asset drifted — and the sync loop caught it, which is what kept operators using it.
the problem class was bounded in writing before any solver ran — which is why the speedup held.
